searchText: <@!550420431744794624> <@!755590043632140352> I just made the deposit progress bar disabled on Pyrmont launchpad. So for the past year(s) rolling out the beacon chain was the major focus of development. What will be the next big focus? Or is it rather split up in many small focus points (like early merge, withdrawals, shards, statelessness, etc)? so once genesis happens, what exactly will happen? - validators will start proposing and attesting for blocks - given enough (>=2/3) of validators agree on the same blocks the first epoch that can be finalized is epoch 4 - deposits that happened after minGenesisTime-genesisDelay (non-genesis-deposits) will get voted for in 64epoch-ranges (so the next validators will get into queue after 32 epochs optimally) is this correct? is there something else worth to be noted? i think the first epoch that can be finalized is epoch 1+2 which will happen during epoch 4 and i thought genesis slot is considered finalized by mutual agreement per the spec, so not sure if that means maybe epoch 3 will be the one to finalize epoch 2 I wrote this up for a testnet a while ago https://notes.ethereum.org/@djrtwo/eth2-launch-metrics It is possible to finalize epoch 1 and/or 2 during the epoch 3 to 4 transition and yes, genesis is considered finalized as a base condition The rest looks correct at 256 epochs, the first "historical batch" gets written, but that's probably not something to publicly track too much thanks 👍

excerpts.author: philcares
excerpts.content: So for the past year(s) rolling out the beacon chain was the major focus of development. What will be the next big focus? Or is it rather split up in many small focus points (like early merge, withdrawals, shards, statelessness, etc)?

excerpts.author: ppf.
excerpts.content:
so once genesis happens, what exactly will happen?
- validators will start proposing and attesting for blocks
- given enough (>=2/3) of validators agree on the same blocks the first epoch that can be finalized is epoch 4
- deposits that happened after minGenesisTime-genesisDelay (non-genesis-deposits) will get voted for in 64epoch-ranges (so the next validators will get into queue after 32 epochs optimally)
is this correct? is there something else worth to be noted?

excerpts.author: schone_wizard
excerpts.content: i think the first epoch that can be finalized is epoch 1+2 which will happen during epoch 4

excerpts.author: schone_wizard
excerpts.content: and i thought genesis slot is considered finalized by mutual agreement per the spec, so not sure if that means maybe epoch 3 will be the one to finalize epoch 2

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content:
I wrote this up for a testnet a while ago
https://notes.ethereum.org/@djrtwo/eth2-launch-metrics

It is possible to finalize epoch 1 and/or 2 during the epoch 3 to 4 transition
and yes, genesis is considered finalized as a base condition

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: at 256 epochs, the first "historical batch" gets written, but that's probably not something to publicly track too much
